analysis.rationale: Manifest decoding, UTC timestamp semantics, canonical full-file rendering, strict byte writing, ownership-aware Check/Sync behavior, source encoding, and the mandatory Windows 11/PowerShell/locale/Git regression matrix converge in one module and one tightly coupled suite; only one end-to-end slice is independently verifiable, while Windows 10 evidence is optional and nonblocking.
analysis.seams_assessment: No stable independent vertical seam exists. Loader/date versus renderer/writer, implementation versus tests, template versus derived ownership, PowerShell hosts, mandatory Windows 11 versus optional Windows 10 evidence, and code versus documentation share contracts or postpone the only observable result; retain one phase-scoped integration writer with five milestones.
analysis.working_set: Medium-high but narrow: six expected write surfaces, roughly 10-14 internal PowerShell helpers, 18 mandatory automated identities, estimated 730-1280 changed lines including tests/docs/generated output; preserve existing plan-wide and slice context ceilings.
